name: Spot the Difference
description: Two grids of coloured shapes side by side; the right one is a copy of the left with a few cells changed (colour, shape, size, a flipped triangle, a small white dot, or a missing or extra object). The model must list exactly the changed cells, and in one case name the kind of each change. Grids grow from 4×4 to 8×8. The whole list must be right: one missed or invented difference scores 0.
hook: Find every difference. Miss one and it is zero.
author: Gauntlet Core

cases.prompt:
The image shows two 4×4 grids of shapes, LEFT and RIGHT. The RIGHT grid is a copy of the LEFT grid with a few cells changed. Cells are named by column letter (A–D, left to right) and row number (1–4, top to bottom), and the same labels are printed on both grids; for example, B3 is column B, row 3. A change can be a different colour, a different shape, a different size, or an object that is missing from one grid. List every cell that differs between the two grids.

End your reply with a JSON object in exactly this form, listing each differing cell once (any order): {"cells": ["A1", "C4"]}
cases.notes: [standard] 4×4 grid, 3 changes: B2 colour, B4 shape, D3 missing. The generator copies LEFT to RIGHT and applies exactly these changes (no two changed cells touch, even diagonally); it asserts that no other cell differs. Generated by verification/vision/spot.mts (seed 12001).
